tests.title: parses the SOUN header with bounded reads that never touch the payload and derives the native packet span
follows siff_read_header in its checks, order and native statuses
probes exactly the 12 bytes siff_probe inspects, detecting SOUN and VBV1
checks the abort signal around every read
registers a frozen demux-only descriptor and routes through the backend, refusing copy of a short tail before any output
matches native SIFF copy framecrc, decode framecrc, WAV, raw u8, AU and s16le for eight rate and bit layouts with whole packets past 65536 samples
matches native SIFF decoding of short final packets and refuses their stream copy, which native flags F=0x3
matches native SIFF packet timing for output -ss, -t and -frames:a, declared -f siff and filtered decode
refuses VBV1, malformed headers, empty-stream headers and input seeks before any output, with native statuses recorded

nativeComparisons.compares: 48 byte-exact outputs (8 layouts: 8000/11025/22050 Hz x 8/16 bits, 8000/24 and 11025/32; whole packets, >65536 samples; copy framecrc, decode framecrc, WAV, copy u8, AU, s16le); 64 byte-exact decodes of 16 short-tail inputs (framecrc, WAV, AU, s16le); 140 byte-exact timing outputs (output -t/-ss/-frames:a incl. -ss beyond EOF and -frames:a 0, copy, filtered asetnsamples=n=700:p=0 decode, plain and declared -f siff, framecrc and WAV); 1 empty-BODY copy framecrc. In addition: 16 native copy framecrc outputs asserted to end in F=0x3 (Edge refuses copy), 12 native exit statuses (183 x9, 256-EINVAL x1, 0 x2), native 'Error during demuxing' at EOF with exit 0, and the absent native siff muxer.

unsupported: VBV1 video files (detected, refused with exit 1)
headers that natively open as empty streams: bits<8, rate 0 (native fails with EINVAL at the muxer), BODY present but file shorter than 36 bytes (refused, exit 1)
-c copy of a short final packet (native F=0x3; refused via copyRefusal)
native 'Error during demuxing' log at EOF is not reproduced
FLAC-path and Workers-runtime evidence (no tests/workers file)

proposedContracts.name: matches native SIFF copy framecrc, decode framecrc, WAV, raw u8, AU and s16le for eight rate and bit layouts with whole packets past 65536 samples
proposedContracts.scope: 8 layouts x 6 outputs byte-exact, whole native packets of rate*(bits>>3) samples past the 16-bit pts wrap.

proposedContracts.name: matches native SIFF decoding of short final packets and refuses their stream copy, which native flags F=0x3
proposedContracts.scope: 16 short-tail inputs decoded byte-exact to 4 outputs; native copy F=0x3 asserted and Edge copy refused before output.

proposedContracts.name: matches native SIFF packet timing for output -ss, -t and -frames:a, declared -f siff and filtered decode
proposedContracts.scope: Output -t/-ss/-frames:a on three inputs, copy and decode (plain, filtered, declared), framecrc and WAV. No input -ss (refused).

proposedContracts.name: refuses VBV1, malformed headers, empty-stream headers and input seeks before any output, with native statuses recorded
proposedContracts.scope: 12 malformed or empty-stream headers with native statuses asserted; Edge refuses all before output. Also the input -ss refusal, EOF demux log, empty BODY and absent muxer.

proposedContracts.name: follows siff_read_header in its checks, order and native statuses
proposedContracts.scope: Every siff_read_header check in order with statuses, zero padding past EOF, ignored fields, empty-stream refusals, budgets. Synthetic inputs, no native run.

notes: Setup durations: sandbox Node was 22.23.5 and bootstrap requires Node 24, so Node 24.11.1 was installed from nodejs.org (about 5 s); npm run bootstrap -- --only npm,submodule,reference --allow-unpinned-reference took 248 s (npm 10.6 s, submodule 8.4 s, reference build the rest); baseline typecheck+lint+boundaries+registry unit tests (3 files, 17 tests passed) took 86 s.
VBV1 is refused with exit 1 rather than native's status: native demuxes VB video (a test file without VBHD gives 183, which the error matrix asserts).
rate 0 natively fails at the muxer's write_header with AVERROR(EINVAL); the test computes 256-os.constants.errno.EINVAL for native and Edge refuses with exit 1 at open.
The timing test raises maxBufferBytes and the filesystem read/write budgets to 4096 because asetnsamples=n=700 holds 700 reframed samples; the other tests use 128.
The differential file runs in about 40 s with --maxWorkers=1 on 4 vCPUs.
No shared edit beyond the registry line was needed.
